sources.title: Broadband and landline faults and problems
sources.geography: United Kingdom broadband and landline customers
facts: The guide explains steps for broadband and landline problems
It directs customers to provider investigation and complaint routes
limitations: General troubleshooting cannot diagnose a specific line
Fault evidence is not parcel-wide availability

sources.title: Unable to pay a bill?
facts: The page explains how to dispute communications charges
It advises contacting the provider about payment difficulties
limitations: Guidance does not determine whether a charge is valid
Payment status does not prove service availability

sources.title: Notifying a phone or broadband provider of a customer's death
facts: The page explains notifying providers after a customer dies
It covers closing or changing the account
limitations: Account administration is not connectivity evidence

sources.title: BT’s landline-only customers
facts: The page addresses protections after earlier commitments expired
It concerns customers buying standalone landline service
limitations: The update applies to a defined customer group
It does not establish broadband coverage

sources.title: Broadband and mobile coverage checker
facts: The checker provides predicted mobile and broadband availability information
Checker outputs use provider-supplied and predictive data
limitations: Checker results require current address entry and do not prove orderability
